intent: Apply the absolute field-reality doctrine to instruction loss: preserve the non-negotiable fall-protection floor while listening to each role's actual received message before closing cause or responsibility.
presentation_rules: The fall-protection condition is a non-negotiable safety floor.
Do not treat the written top instruction as a complete explanation of what the last worker actually received.
Listen to role-specific field accounts before assigning cause or blame.
Site relationships and schedule pressure explain behavior but never exempt the safety floor.
Every responsible route must expose time, relationship, evidence, or production costs; do not add a consequence-free correct-answer badge.
